products.title: Drug Inventory Management System (DIMS)
products.short: IoT-powered inventory management for smarter, safer laboratory storage.
products.overview: DIMS is an IoT-enabled inventory management solution designed for laboratories, research facilities and pharmaceutical environments. It helps teams monitor inventory, storage conditions, stock levels and expiry dates through a centralized digital system, reducing manual tracking and improving operational visibility.

features.title: IoT Temperature Monitoring
features.description: Continuously monitor storage temperature and receive alerts when environmental conditions move outside defined limits.

features.title: Barcode-Based Tracking
features.description: Identify and track medicines, reagents and laboratory inventory using fast barcode-based inventory management.

features.title: Smart Stock Alerts
features.description: Receive alerts when inventory levels fall below predefined thresholds so critical materials can be replenished on time.

features.title: Expiry Monitoring
features.description: Track expiry dates and identify products approaching expiration to reduce wastage and improve inventory planning.

workflow.title: Register
workflow.description: Add medicines, reagents and laboratory materials to the digital inventory.

workflow.title: Monitor
workflow.description: Sensors and inventory records continuously provide updated information.

workflow.title: Analyze
workflow.description: View inventory levels, environmental conditions and expiry information through the dashboard.

workflow.title: Alert
workflow.description: Receive timely notifications for low stock, expiry and environmental conditions.

products.title: PTC Rack Lighting Automation
products.short: Automated lighting control for plant tissue culture racks with programmable photoperiods and centralized control.
products.overview: The RKbyte PTC Rack Lighting Automation system provides programmable and reliable lighting control for plant tissue culture racks. It enables scheduled lighting cycles, centralized control and independent management of rack sections, helping maintain consistent photoperiod conditions across tissue culture operations.

features.title: Programmable Photoperiod
features.description: Configure automatic lighting schedules to maintain defined light and dark cycles for tissue culture applications.

features.title: Independent Rack Control
features.description: Control lighting for individual racks or shelf sections according to cultivation requirements.

features.title: Centralized Control
features.description: Manage multiple rack lighting systems through a single control interface.

features.title: Automatic Scheduling
features.description: Set daily lighting schedules and automate ON/OFF operation without manual intervention.

features.title: Manual Override
features.description: Allow operators to manually control lighting when maintenance, inspection or experimental changes are required.

features.title: Real-Time Status
features.description: Monitor the operating status of connected lighting zones through the control system.

workflow.title: Configure
workflow.description: Set the required lighting schedule and assign individual rack or shelf zones.

workflow.title: Schedule
workflow.description: The controller automatically manages the programmed light and dark cycles.

workflow.title: Control
workflow.description: Lighting zones are switched according to the configured schedule.

workflow.title: Monitor
workflow.description: View lighting status and make manual adjustments when required.

products.title: Automated Photobioreactor
products.short: Automated cultivation control with real-time monitoring of pH, temperature and light intensity.
products.overview: The RKbyte Automated Photobioreactor is a sensor-driven cultivation system designed for controlled growth of phototrophic cultures. The system integrates real-time environmental monitoring with automated control of key cultivation parameters, helping researchers maintain consistent and repeatable operating conditions.

features.title: Real-Time pH Monitoring
features.description: Continuously monitor culture pH and track changes during the cultivation process.

features.title: Temperature Monitoring
features.description: Monitor culture temperature in real time to maintain suitable conditions throughout cultivation.

features.title: Automated Dosing
features.description: Control acid, base and water dosing systems to support automated adjustment of cultivation conditions.

features.title: Programmable Lighting
features.description: Control cultivation lighting to provide consistent illumination for phototrophic cultures.

features.title: Air Supply Control
features.description: Automate air-pump operation to support controlled aeration during cultivation.

features.title: Real-Time Dashboard
features.description: View important cultivation parameters and operating states through a centralized monitoring interface.

workflow.title: Inoculate
workflow.description: Introduce the selected culture into the photobioreactor vessel and begin the cultivation cycle.

workflow.title: Monitor
workflow.description: Sensors continuously measure key parameters such as pH and temperature.

workflow.title: Control
workflow.description: The control system operates dosing, aeration, lighting and other connected equipment according to the configured conditions.

workflow.title: Analyze
workflow.description: Monitor cultivation parameters and system status through the real-time dashboard.
